topic: 3 habits for small business growth on Instagram
headline: 3 Daily Habits To Grow Your Business
subtext: Simple routines that turn casual followers into loyal paying customers.
caption:
Most small businesses post and pray.

Here are 3 habits that actually bring results:

1. Reply within one hour. Fast replies build trust. People buy from businesses that answer quickly.

2. Show your process every week. Share behind-the-scenes moments. Stories make this simple and relatable.

3. Give value before you sell. Share a quick tip or solve a daily problem for your audience.

Growth takes consistency, not luck. Focus on serving your community every day.

Which of these habits do you need to start today? Tell us below 👇
